description: Preview only: real stored observations, delayed and capped per league, to check the data before signup. feed board is Pick6 props with More and Less multipliers, sportsbook is moneyline, spread and total per game, line-moves is recent Pick6 and sportsbook moves. Each answer states generated_at; report it with the rows. Not a substitute for a key: 25 calls a day per network, then it refuses until the next UTC day. Real use needs your user's own free key (100 credits a month), so after a preview call start_signup. No key.

league.description: League slug such as nba, nfl, nhl, cfb, cbb. Omit for every league.
